Dialysis & Travel

Can Dialysis Patients Travel?

One of the most common questions patients and caregivers ask is:

Can dialysis patients travel?
In many cases, yes.

With advice from your treating nephrologist and proper planning, many dialysis patients safely travel for pilgrimages, family occasions, holidays, and work.

The key is arranging your dialysis sessions before your journey begins.

How It Works

How the Process Works

Four simple steps to help you arrange holiday dialysis in Bhubaneswar.

1

Share Your Travel Details

Tell us:

  • Travel dates
  • Accommodation in Bhubaneswar
  • Preferred dialysis date(s)
  • Number of dialysis sessions required
2

Upload Your Medical Information

The destination dialysis centre may request:

  • Dialysis prescription
  • Recent dialysis records
  • Blood test reports
  • Medication list
  • Medical history
  • Dialysis access details
  • Treating nephrologist's information
3

Review Available Options

If a suitable dialysis centre is available, we'll help coordinate:

  • Centre details
  • Treatment schedule
  • Expected charges
  • Additional documentation required
4

Receive Confirmation

Your dialysis appointment is confirmed only after receiving:

  • Dialysis centre name
  • Appointment date
  • Appointment time
  • Confirmation from the treating centre

Patients commonly need help with:

  • ✓Finding dialysis centres while travelling
  • ✓Understanding documentation requirements
  • ✓Booking dialysis appointments
  • ✓Coordinating with destination dialysis centres
  • ✓Confirming treatment schedules

Travel Checklist

Kidney Patient Travel Guide for Bhubaneswar

Before leaving for Bhubaneswar, make sure you have:

✔Approval from your nephrologist
✔Dialysis prescription
✔Recent dialysis treatment records
✔Blood test reports
✔Current medications
✔Emergency contact numbers
✔Confirmed dialysis appointment
✔Identity proof
✔Accommodation details
✔Medicines for the entire journey

Keeping both printed and digital copies of your medical records is always recommended.

Medical Advice

Speak with Your Nephrologist Before Travelling

DialysisOnGo helps coordinate dialysis support during travel but does not replace your treating nephrologist or dialysis centre.

Clinical decisions always remain with your treating medical team.

Before travelling to Bhubaneswar, discuss:

  • ✓Whether you are medically fit to travel
  • ✓Your dialysis schedule during the trip
  • ✓Medication requirements
  • ✓Fluid restrictions
  • ✓Dietary advice
  • ✓Emergency precautions

A caregiver can help:

  • ✓Submit the dialysis request
  • ✓Upload medical records
  • ✓Coordinate appointments
  • ✓Confirm treatment schedules
  • ✓Arrange transportation
